column1: # Rows db.evnan.tn.* (line RG, X-evalue-nan, 2026-11-28): tblastn `-evalue -nan` and `+inf`: Spouge's cutoff 0 without -searchsp (blast_stat.c:5236-5269), the reaps that drop an HSP only when its e-value is greater than -evalue (blast_hits.c:1976-2003; NaN keeps every HSP), the composition-based redo's test of the best e-value (blast_kappa.c:3687; NaN keeps no match), sum statistics off and a PSSM query. tab_tbn_q.faa and ps7_ts1_tslice.asn.gz against tslice, outfmt 6.

# Rows db.evnan.tbn.o1[35].* (line RG, X-evalue-nan, 2026-11-28): the JSON reports with `-evalue` NaN or infinite. NCBI's JSON stream throws at the report's params.expect after its key (objostrjson.cpp:210-217: its 802.5 post, CSerialException eInvalidData); outfmt 15's report function catches it (blastxml2_format.cpp:879-890: the exception's post, the next report after its separator, the document's end, exit status 0), 13's does not (the side file ends at the key, the master file stays empty, exit status 255).
